# doit_service_account (Data Source)

Manage non-human identities whose API tokens call the DoiT API with a fixed set of permissions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    doit = {
      source = "doitintl/doit"
    }
  }
}

variable "service_account_name" {
  type    = string
  default = "terraform-service-account-data-source-example"
}

resource "doit_service_account" "example" {
  name        = var.service_account_name
  description = "Example account for a data source lookup"
  permissions = ["budgetsReadOnly"]
}

data "doit_service_account" "ci" {
  id = doit_service_account.example.id
}

output "service_account_name" {
  value = data.doit_service_account.ci.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Service account ID, as returned in the id field by the list and create operations.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) When the service account was created.
- `created_by` (String) Display name of the user who created the service account. `null` when unknown or when the service account was created with a service account token.
- `created_by_email` (String) Email of the user who created the service account. `null` when unknown or when the service account was created with a service account token.
- `created_by_user_id` (String) ID of the user who created the service account. `null` when unknown or when the service account was created with a service account token.
- `customer_id` (String) ID of the customer that owns the service account.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `etag` (String) Current version of the service account. Send it in `If-Match` to update or delete.
- `name` (String) Name, unique among the customer's service accounts.
- `permissions` (List of String) Platform permission names in camelCase, as shown in the DoiT console role editor.
- `update_time` (String) When the service account was last changed.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
